notes.title: Patch Notes 1.10.37 (Phase 4)
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes 1.10.37[/h1]

[h1]General[/h1]
Dark Wraith's stun walls have been fixed and now works as intended,
You can now mouse over Events in the Calendar UI,
Teleporting other guilds from towers has been fixed,
You can no longer be mounted when joining Echo Chamber Event,
Owning a Guild Tower no longer prevents capturing a new Guild Tower,¹.¹
Reviving at a Check Point will always face your character downwards,
Instances are now live,¹.²
New Dungeon UI added,¹.²
Echo Chamber access moved to Dungeon UI,
New Wave based Dungeon called Assault added to the Dungeon UI,
reset command added to remove all transform buffs,².²
Added reset & time to help,
Moved help from the Chat to it's own UI,
Client no longer freezes/goes white when caching textures,
Cards are now displayed before Login Rewards,³.¹
Transformed Characters can now enter the Echo Chamber event,².¹
Dungeon and Event button added to the main UI,
Characters can no longer drop Currency or Stackables on Dungeon Maps (Orange name),
Quiz Event's time has being correctly set to the time in the Event UI,
Removed 'Skywyre' from the loading screen fading animations,
Amended the Credits screen,
Battle Rating list can no longer contain staff members,
Rank UI now has a '->' to switch between Level Rankings and Battle Ratings,
Fixed the positioning of the '->'s in the Character Window,
Prevented Warping on all Dungeon Maps (Orange name),
Confirmation System added in,³.²
'+ 0 EXP' no longer shows if you gain 0 Experience from a kill,
Bosses will no longer walk onto a tile which holds a character unless "stuck",⁴.¹ 
Bosses no longer back up Spells and attacks to unleash fury on the next player who enters,
Epic items can no longer be obtained from the ReRoll Machine,
Mobs can no longer spawn inside walls,
Day/Night messages removed and replaced by Sun/Moon Icon near World Time,
Inventory Icon replaced with a pouch image,
Guild and Talent icons have being switched,
Title Icon replaced with a better alternative,
Option Icon replaced with a place holder (Old skills icon),
Crafted items now show the Crafters name & craft date when hovering over,
Secondary layer of item security implemented to assist admins with tracking/bugs,
Auction UI's font is now all the same, rather than 2 different fonts,
Switching between accounts no longer causes steep FPS drops,
Switching between accounts no longer causes mapping errors that are fixed by relogging,
Switching between accounts no longer cause DX8 Error's,
Delga Temple cliffs are now blocked correctly to prevent backstabbing onto cliff sides,
Moved 'Craft 5' and 'Craft Max' to the left of the Crafting UI,
Added Recipe Book to the bottom right of the Crafting UI with a Search option,⁴.²
Dragging any Crafting Materials to a Crafting station will close Inventory,
Hard coded shortcuts for ingame menu buttons added,
Fixed wrong message for 15% Platinum Bonus Event,
All Known Recipes (Only very early accounts would have these) have been deleted,
Fixed "Known Recipes" to now work with newer content,

[h1]SpellsItems[/h1]
Venom Strike's stats have been reduced,
Green Goblin graphic fixed,
Foolish Garb's graphic fixed,

[h1]Recipes[/h1]
Farsight now requires the Recipe to craft,
All Cudgel's now require 4 bars and 1 plank of it's tier materials to craft.
__Dungeons__
Echo Chamber is now instanced,
Echo Chamber's Exp reduced to 5,000,
To enter an instance whilst in a Party, the Party Leader must enter which takes other party members with them,¹.²
All messages about waves warnings use the System Message instead of Chat,

[h1]Note[/h1]
¹.¹ If you own any Guild Tower, you forfeit control of it _if_ you take another Guild Tower.
¹.² All Characters must be on the map with the entrance  only the Party Leader can enter which takes the entire Party in.
².¹ Transforms no longer class as Mounts when entering Echo.
².² The Spell will remain on Cooldown.
³.¹ Choosing a card offers a chance to obtain an extra bonus item in your Daily Login
Rewards. Day 1-5 +1 Potion (Varying) Day 6-7 +1 Plat
³.² To confirm the action you must click 'Yes' or 'No'. Confirmation is required to Drop/Sell
Epic or Legendary Items, to Drop 1 million Gold or more and enter any Dungeon.
⁴.¹ If they have dealt no damage to their target in 10 seconds, they enter Stuck status, and to prevent abuse they can then walk through Characters until not Stuck.
⁴.² Search can include Equipment Slots (head, body, weapon or offhand), Item Names (staff, mask, platemail or wand) or tiers like t1 tier1 tier 1.

https://discord.gg/purKsGt

notes.title: The Past 12 Months
notes.content:
In light of the changes that have been made within the past year, the Life Forge team is happy to announce that we've completed our checklist. Now that we've caught up with all previous roadmap / announced ideas, We've opened up a new realm of possibilities for Life Forge!
With that said, we'd love to invite you all to view our roadmap for the following month. 

1: PVP Volcanic island with various high end resources allowing players to literally fight there way to the top!
2: Flushed out content from the beginning of the game. We're looking to further the experience at the beginning of the game, seeing as we've mainly focused on end game content. Expect flushed out contnet in area's between the levels of 1-30.
3: More raids and dungeons are coming!  Look forward to delving into the depths of the sea, as well as the innards of a active Volcano!
4: Quests Galore! Expect a huge increase in quests, including a massive quest line that will bring the world of Life Forge together! 
5: ?
The following patch notes below are the results of a hard years work on life forge up until now.

[h1] [b] New Areas: [/b] [/h1]
- Duskin Pyramid
- FireFly Forest
- Delga Jungle
- Delga Temple
- Draken Marsh
- Gulta Village
- Ironstar Deadlands
- Marken Island
- Emerald Hills
- Melvernia Caves
- Charlin
- TinderFrost Woods
- Fungoid Caverns
- Glacial Tower
- Melvernia Forest
- Cursed ore Mine
- Mousling Caverns
- Frozen Tombs

[h1] [b] Systems: [/b]  [/h1]
- Auctions House
- Randomized Item Drops
- Loot now spawns within a 3x3 'Loot Grid' around the slain Mob
- Shared Loot system that extends the 3x3 'Loot Grid' to a 5x5 'Loot Grid' and removes owned security
- Player Housing
- Boss Mechanics
- Better Crafting UI with Tools
- Guild Controlled Towers
- Weapon Arts
- Daily Login Rewards
- Races
- Alchemy
- Mount Overhaul
- Cosmetics
- Multiple Realms with shared data
- Changable Keybinds
- Smarter A.I
- Improved Tutorial
- Resources now have Randomized min/max HP value
- Scalable Weapons
- Optional Swear Filter
- Major UI Changes
- Multiple Hotbars

[h1] [b] Spells/Items: [/b]   [/h1]
- 'House Warp' Spell had it's icon changed to something original,
- Stats lost from shields when equipping a 2-h weapon has been patched,
- Horned Edge (Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3) is removed when changing class Blademaster to Guardian,
- Earthsong (Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3) is removed when changing class Muse to Jester,
- 'Desert Dulcimer' is now 2% Lethality,
- 'Balefire Dulcimer' is now 2-H, 3% Lethality and Requires 210 Will,
- 'Cursed Dulcimer' now Requires 190 Will and has 4.5% Reflect Chance,
- Blink Spell Type has an 15% chance to reset cool down when casting,
- Blink Spell Type had a complete overhaul and no longer uses 'Player Warp',
- Anti-Stealth spell Type now gets removed correctly from the caster on duration end,
- When Stealthing, any player who has you as a Target has their Target removed.

[h1] [b] General:  [/b] [/h1]
- Maximum Level Cap increased to 80
- Tier 7 Crafting
- Frostpine/Ice Koi/Frostfire Ore rebalanced to 800 (from 700)
- Auction Items that expire or sell whilst offline are no longer awarded on login*
- Pressing the Return key replicates "yes" on the currency menu
- /collectfurniture has been changed to /collectf
- /collectf has been added to /help
- Added minimize option to Main Menu
- Immunity Status on Map change (20s) and Login (30s) now working correctly. Attacking, Moving, Spell casting all remove this Status
- 'Member Revives' now heal 75% HP and have "+75% Health" scrolling Action Message and shows in Description
- Dragging an Item to an 'Crafting Station' no longer breaks Hover over UI
- Loot can no longer drop on any tile that is not walkable
- Mt. Ironstar maps no longer spawn Mobs on the left hand side
- Mobs can no longer spawn on NPC Avoid tiles
- 'Amount Input' breaking chat fix applied
- 'News' System for those whom do not wish to join the Discord server
 - The Minotaur now teleports it's target to it
- "Quest Complete" texture with fading added
- Enchant/Charm/Ring/Whetstone now display their provided Defense on the Character panel
- Stealth Detection spell type added
- New Buff Icon "Alert" for Anti Stealth indication
- Blink spell type added
- When targeting a stealthed player now, the Target Indicator removed once they stealth
- Improved Client Defense calculations on the client for better performance
- Fixed minor server side error dealing with Damage prediction
- Fixed several issues with the Path Finding on NPC's
- Root Queen's 5k hits when she heals and you're on the same tile as her
- All Client sided System Messages moved to Sys Msg system
- Housing Collectables had their Value greatly reduced
- Auction Listings now display their correct crit instead of "0%"
- Stealthing no longer removes your target
- 'Dark Wraith Spawn' Attack Speed reduced from 2 Attacks Per Second to 1.5 Attacks Per Second
- Items dropped by a Player will always land on the tile it was dropped,
- All items/gold from the Auction will enter the Collection Chest, Unless you win it/buy out directly in the AH
- New Bard Class.

[h1] [b] Housing:  [/b] [/h1]
- Can't put 'House Deed' in the Auction House,
- Can no longer drop 'House Deed' if it matches your current 'House',
- House wall in 'Gandor [L]' is no longer walk-through,
- Tree borderline (both) in 'Gandor [L]' missing blocks,
- Cliff Edge near top Mining spot in 'Gandor [L]' is no longer walk-through,
- Gulta Swamp House now displays Furniture Limit,
- Houses are now Tradeable. You MAY not trade ANY deed that matches your current house,
- Presents now are a Daily collectable from 'Christmas Tree',
- Players can no longer be invited to a home when in Survival, Dungeon, PvP or Tower Map Types.

 [h1] [b] Crafting: [/b]   [/h1]
- 'Craft 5' Now works,
- 'Appleroot Flask' is now a 150 HP Buff,
- Complete changes to all areas of Crafting and their Recipes.

[h1] [b] Classes: [/b]   [/h1]
DPS classes now have different Damage bonuses depending on the classes (minor between them), Tanks now have Defense Bonuses and Hybrids get a little of both.

Apprentice: Damage (Default - INT)
Necro: Defense (Tank)
Wizard: Damage (DPS - INT)
Cleric: Defense (Hybrid) Damage  (H - WILL)

Page: Defense (Default)
Knight: Defense (Hybrid) Damage (Hybrid - STR)
Guardian: Defense (Tank)
BM: Damage (DPS - STR)

Hunter: Damage (Default - AGI)
Ranger: Defense (Hybrid) Damage  (H - AGI)
Warden: Defense (Tank)
Shade: Damage (DPS - AGI)

Bard: Damage (Default - WILL)
Jester: Damage (DPS - WILL)
Minstrel: Defense (Tank)
Muse: Defense (Hybrid) Damage (Hybrid - WILL)

[h1] [b] Mounts: [/b]   [/h1]
Health:
- Nova Phoenix from 2550 to 3350,
- Top Hat Raptor from 2300 to 3000,
- Gorgan from 3800 to 3000.
Speed:
-Yeti from Speed reduced to 2,
- Nova Phoenix Speed reduced to 4,
- Phantom Roc Speed reduced to 4,
- Top Hat Raptor Speed reduced to 3,
- Green Raptor Speed reduced to 3,
- Green Toad Speed reduced to 3,
- Balefire Phoenix reduced to 4,
- Blue Raptor Speed reduced to 3,
- Frostback Penguin Speed reduced to 2,
- Gorgan Speed reduced to 2,
- Penguin Speed reduced to 2.

[h1] [b] Notes: [/b] [/h1]
*Auction Items now require you to interact with an Collection Chest inside any auction house to collect your item(s) or Gold. This is to increase performance and login times.**'Shared Loot' allows any Character to pick the Loot up instantly. This removes the 30 second "Last Kill is Owner" protection.
We'd like to thank everyone for coming on this journey with us! In the months and years to come, we hope to bring Life Forge up to the potential it deserves! 

We hope to see you in-game!
Life Forge Team

notes.content:

-Blinding Ballad Cast Time -3s
-Waking Dreams CD + 10s
-Bards can now learn Flash
-Ballad of Hope nerfed (-2/-2/-1 Vital/Spell Level)
-Siphoning Song buffed
-Gator Spell buffed
-Flamespirit Spell Buff Changed to Willpower
-Deadly Melody buffed
-Song of Strength renamed to Stoic Tune
-Harmful Tune buff
-New Jester Spell "Dark Echo"
-New Muse Spell "Earthsong"
-New "Bard" gear drops

~GENERAL BALANCE~
-Maximum Weapon Speed is now 0.3s
-Blademaster has a new Skill! "Honed Edge"
-Cleric has a new Spell! "Spiritflame"


~WHAT'S TO COME~
Next update we want to have a full Main-Questline in place. This coupled with brand new zones, PvP rebalance, tons of side-quests, new PvP Zones, a new PvP Tower, and gameplay improvements, next update is sure to be a hit! Be sure to keep up to date with all things Life Forge!

notes.title: Alpha Patch v1.6.0
notes.content:
FEATURES
-Daily Login Rewards! These go up in rarity and usefullness as you login 

daily. This goes up to a streak of 7, then it resets!
-Your Mount's health is now displayed in your Health Bar while mounted. 

Hold the Tab key to see your character's health while mounted.
-A new /roll function makes rolling for gear drops with your parties and 

guilds!
-Quest icons are now above quest holder's heads in the early game. Give 

us a bit to put them over all quest holders!

CONTENT
-3 New Bosses
-Dozens of New Items
-Several New Zones
-Several New Quests

-New Low-Level "Dungeon"

-New Class! The Bard has come to Life Forge along with its advancements: 

Jester, Minstrel, and Muse!
-New "Music" weapon typing that scales with Willpower.

-Many New Cosmetics
-Several New Mounts

BALANCE
-Valor Strike Cooldown increased by 2 seconds
-All Attack buffs are now weighted differently. You should see a big 

increase in effectiveness and power while buffed with and Attack buff!
-Firefly Stag has had its Health increased to 3500!
-Several Older Mounts have recieved health buffs.
-Darkrose has gained a new Weapon Art


QUALITY OF LIFE
-We've slowly started to cycle out smaller maps that render in an ugly 

way on larger resolutions. Given more time, we intend to do this for all 

maps we deem too small!

BUGS
-Major Bug Fixes
-Minor Bug Fixes


What you can expect next is an explosion of polished, enjoyable quest 

content, as well as a main questline. Also look forward to tons of new 

content in general and more and more polish as we go! Thank you all for 

supporting Life Forge! See you all in-game!
